scope: Regular untracked-file stat failure must not be swallowed before acceptance of a cached checkpoint receipt.
changes: state_hash explicitly propagates untracked-list/stat failures and handles empty lists without a grep status ambiguity
cmd_push refuses a failed state_hash before cache comparison
cmd_status refuses a failed state_hash before claiming the cache is current

observed_software_validation.scope: Local isolated fixtures, uploader stubs always refuse; includes synthetic prior receipt with a newly added untracked file and both gate/status refusal.
observed_software_validation.recording: Root records the actual tool result; this is not an independent scientific review.

limits: No complete security audit of checkpoint caching
No authenticated upload or restore test
No arithmetic result or scientific admission
